data.name: Soulframe
data.detailed_description:
Rise as an Envoy in a living world besieged by conquerors. Live alongside your Ancestors and manifest primal aspects of the natural world in your defense. Combine the strength of your Pacts, Weapons and Virtues solo or with friends to take back Midrath and free the Omen Beasts from the Ode.

Rise, Envoy

The Spellsong, that enchanted melody that sounded over Alca on Ode'n Descent, caused all to forget. Forget their rites, their divine Omen Beasts, themselves. Now, the people of Alca can only believe their rulers have always been so: their right to rule as sure as the rising of twin suns Mora and Saphene. The Omen Beasts they worshipped lay defiled, corrupted by Ode'n Ichor. Their pact may have granted strength enough to rebel against Alca's invaders, yet none remain to free them of their bindings. None but you, Envoy.



Your blood is that of ancient Fey, not so easily swayed by the Ode'n Magicks draped over the land. It falls to you to dam the steady flow of ichorous corruption and heal the worldflesh of Alca. For none are beyond saving, and it is never too late to be redeemed.

Feybled Arms

The bonds you forge with Omen Beasts manifest as Pacts, granting Arcanic abilities in your shared rebellion against the Ode. Whether you favour Courage, Grace, or Spirit, embody your chosen Virtues to match your approach. Courage, a heroic charge into the fray. Grace, the sly stealth of roguish tricksters or the patient aim of marksmen hunters. Spirit, attuned to the flows of magick deep in Alca's roots. Wield blade, bow, and magick to great effect as you craft and master your chosen Weapons. Swap freely between Weapons, Pacts, and Loadouts you've earned so far to meet any challenge.

Wander and Wonder

You awaken on the shore, stripped of all but your breath. Venture forth, explore the isle of Midrath, and begin your journey. Much awaits you in these lands oppressed. Take on Fables to aid the benighted Omen Beasts, seek out World Trees to uncover the land's splendour, liberate captured fortresses in Sieges, discover hidden Enclaves that yet resist, and complete Votives to strike back against the Ode. Venture deep below the surface in the Dermak Undercity, Glades of Anduin, or Neath'uns, whose formation of corridors and halls is ever-shifting.

Conscious Cooperation

Though you are but one Envoy, you are not alone. Join forces and form parties of up to four to rally against formidable challenges or simply explore together.

An Envoy All Your Own

Your frame is none but your own, and you are encouraged to play in the way that fits you best. Combine Pacts, Virtues, Weapons, Runes, and Armor to build your ideal Envoy, and freely swap between loadouts outside of combat using the Nightfold. With Ancestor's aid, Bestitch your gear with Moonsteel Thread to change the appearance of your Armor and express your personal style.

data.short_description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 860, Intel Core i5 750, or AMD FX-4100 (SSE 4.2 support required)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11+ capable Graphics Card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
